notes: Mask-fixed three-head Double+Dueling DQN v2 action contract saved as v3 model artifacts.
Top-level aliases use explainability/PnL compromise checkpoints, not simply the best test-PnL fold.
The 1h model is the strongest project candidate: nominal gate pass, zero invalid actions, fold 0 selected for clearest width reasoning.
The 15min model is packaged as an interpretable high-PnL candidate, but did not beat the paper rule in enough folds to be called a full pass.
The 5min model is saved for comparison/demo, but is weaker than 1h and did not beat the paper rule in the first serious gate.

1h.alias_selection_note: Fold 0 is used as the top-level alias because it has the clearest autonomous width-selection story: W4/W10/W20 are all meaningful, with some cash/exits and positive held-out PnL. Fold 3 remains in the fold bundle as the higher-PnL alternate.

15min.alias_selection_note: Fold 3 is used as the top-level alias because it balances explainable width selection with positive held-out PnL; fold 2 is more mixed but weaker on PnL.
